title: Quantum Entanglement Explained
text:
Quantum entanglement describes a physical phenomenon where two or more particles become linked in such a way that they share the same existence, regardless of the spatial separation between them. These coupled particles exist in a combined quantum state, meaning the properties of one particle cannot be described independently from the others.

The core implication arises when a measurement is performed on one entangled particle. At that moment, its specific state (such as spin or polarization) instantly dictates the corresponding state of all other linked particles, even if they are separated by vast distances. This correlation suggests non-local connections within nature, prompting profound investigation into the fundamental limits of physics and information transfer.
